command.name: Eclipse Fervor
verbatim: Each Round: 25% chance to afflict Panic (Damage Rate: +20%) on 1 Enemy within adjacency for 2 rounds.
Rounds 4, 7, 9, 10: Deal Physical Damage to 2 Enemies within adjacency (Damage Rate: +80%).
At 10 Stars: On Round 9: Deal Physical and Tactical Damage to 3 Enemies in any lane (Damage Rate: +100% per type).

vanguard.name: Warrior's Zeal
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Physical Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Midnight Aura
habits.verbatim: Start of Rounds 7-10: Increase Strength and Instinct (enhanced by Initiative) of 3 Allies in any lane until the end of the round.

habits.name: Nimble Resilience
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce your Damage Received and increase your Initiative until the end of combat.

habits.name: Fueled by Darkness
habits.verbatim: Each Round: chance to grant Advantage to 2 Allies in any lane for 2 rounds, doubled while Midnight Aura is active.

habits.name: Midnight Mastery
habits.verbatim: Start of Rounds 7-10: Increase Physical and Tactical Damage Dealt of 3 Allies in any lane until the end of the round.

habits.name: Event Horizon
habits.verbatim: Eclipse Fervor gains: On Round 9: Deal Physical and Tactical Damage to 3 Enemies in any lane (Damage Rate: +100% per type).

formation_needs: Left Flank ally benefiting from Instinct and Initiative
